8.content: Rate moves highest (e.g., 100) if they reduce Manhattan distance to G or directly approach it, and land on F (open) cells; always rate moves landing on H cells 0 first, overriding all other heuristics regardless of distance change. Rate staying in place or redundant moves lower than progress toward G.

9.content: Rate moves lower (e.g., <90) if they increase distance to G or approach H.

11.content: Prioritize right/down in open F paths toward bottom-right G.

14.content: Rate moves that increase Manhattan distance to G lower (e.g., <50), even if landing on F, unless part of a clear detour around obstacles; penalize backtracking moves (e.g., reversing direction immediately) below 50.

15.content: Rate down or right moves to F cells >=90 if they maintain or reduce distance to G, especially when adjacent to H obstacles blocking straight paths.
